originalTitle: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 | Multiplayer Trailer
content: Weapons hot. Apex Attachments activated. Killstreaks online. 12 all-new 6v6 Maps, Kill Block and Ground War locked in. This is Modern Warfare 4 Multiplayer. Pre-Order now to get Early Access to the MW4 Beta: https://a.atvi.com/PreOrder-MW4 🎵 "The Devil Is a Lie" by Rick Ross feat. Jay-Z Modern Warfare 4 Multiplayer delivers grounded, precise combat built around fluid movement that provides greater control in every fight. Day one, players deploy across all-new 6v6 maps set in visually and tactically distinct locations around the world. In addition, large-scale maps bring vehicle and infantry combat to locations shaped by the campaign’s global conflict. From tight, close-quarters combat to open battlefield engagements, Multiplayer is designed to keep every fight fast, tactical, and competitive. Kill Block introduces a dynamic new Multiplayer battleground where the map reconfigures layouts between rounds, reshaping sightlines, routes, and cover to keep players adapting in real time. Assembled from a set of new purpose-built sections, Kill Block can generate more than 500 distinct configurations, with each one designed to create its own combat rhythm and tactical challenges. Built for high-intensity play, it forces players to adapt on the fly and fight for control every round. Movement is built for smoother transitions and greater control, giving players new ways to push forward, change angles, and adapt under pressure. Gunplay balances authenticity with responsiveness.
